title: BMI Appoints Todd Horvath as President/COO
summary: The executive will report to CEO Mike O'Neill.
contentText:
BMI has named Todd Horvath as president/COO, effective Monday (Jan. 26). In his new role, Horvath will report to CEO Mike O’Neill as he leads BMI’s work to modernize its platforms, identify new sources of revenue and elevate the affiliate experience. Horvath will split his time between BMI’s offices in Nashville and New York.

Horvath’s new role on the BMI leadership team will enable O’Neill to focus on the strategic vision for the company. O’Neill recently extended his contract through 2029.

Horvath joins BMI from Equifax, where he served as president of U.S. information systems. He was previously president of banking solutions for Fiserv, where he led multiple billion-dollar divisions and drove technology initiatives, including additional digital banking offerings. Prior to that, Horvath spent 15 years at ADP, overseeing the company’s international business as president of multinational clients.

“I’m excited to welcome Todd to BMI as we build upon the many efforts we’ve undertaken over the past three years to create long term value for our affiliates,” O’Neill said in a statement. “Todd’s unique skill set is a perfect complement to our team, and I look forward to his contributions as we continue to drive growth and position BMI for the future.”

“I’m honored to join BMI at a time of great change and opportunity in the industry,” Horvath added. “I’ve spent a good deal of time getting to know Mike over the past few months, and I am excited by his vision for the company and BMI’s mission on behalf of its songwriters, composers and publishers. I look forward to working with the entire team at BMI to unleash additional opportunities that will continue to position BMI as the leading PRO in the business.”
